description:
FreeSurfer's mri_synthmorph register with its defaults (regularisation 0.5, 7 integration steps, extent 256), the deformable model alone: a network trained on synthetic brain images of any contrast. The ImagingBenchmarks baseline synthmorph. Brain MR, aligned pairs: the tool's help says the deformable model assumes prior affine alignment. What the official image freesurfer/synthmorph holds, without a container: the script and its package from FreeSurfer's repository at a pinned commit, the weights (3.5 GB) checked against their hash, and TensorFlow 2.17 on Python 3.12 in an environment uv builds on first use (7 GB). A GPU is recommended, up to the Ada generation: TensorFlow 2.17 has no kernels for Blackwell GPUs, so there the app runs on the CPU (no --gpu). Masks are ignored by this baseline. Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS).

How to cite:
M. Hoffmann et al., Anatomy-aware and acquisition-agnostic joint registration with SynthMorph, Imaging Neuroscience 2024.
